name: thinklight
description: Camera LED busy-light hooks for Claude Code and Codex

plugins.name: thinklight
plugins.description: macOS only. Turn the Mac camera LED into an AI busy light: on = the agent is working, off = done, your turn. Opens the camera to light the LED and discards every frame; hooks write a local session token and read no prompt content. Optional sound, off until you ask for it. Requires the thinklight programs in ~/.local/bin
